name: Katrina Kaif (Kamli & Zoya)
title: Action Diva & Secret Agent Zoya
description: The Bollywood dancing powerhouse and elite undercover operative Zoya enters with blazing acrobatics, twin tactical SMGs, and show-stopping dance cyclone rhythms. Slices web pages with Kamli Tornado Spins, Chikni Chameli Fireworks, and Zoya Parkour Flips.

attacks.name: Kamli Whirlwind Dance Cyclone
attacks.description: Executes rapid 360-degree aerial dance twirls generating a dazzling pink-magenta cyclone that shreds web elements.

attacks.name: Zoya Akimbo SMG Storm
attacks.description: Draws dual tactical blasters in acrobatic slow-motion cartwheels, raining laser suppressive fire across DOM containers.

attacks.name: Sheila Ki Jawani Stardust Blast
attacks.description: Detonates a glamorous high-voltage glitter explosion that blinds, bedazzles, and shatters web components.

voicelines: My name is Sheila, Sheila ki jawani!
